tagline: Jev skis the slalom, threading each gate as it sweeps by, live

examples.prompt: Set Jev Slalom up as a hard run — push the descent speed up near the limit. Give Jev a decisive line-up-early style, then watch it read the next gate every tick, carve the valley, thread every gate (or clip one and fall when the speed gets too hot).
examples.caption: Jev's Run — a fast decision model carving a slalom line and threading each gate on every tick
